map.MSISDN 验证器（手机号）。输入带国家码的移动号码，校验数字及 +、空格、连: MSISDN validator (mobile number). Enter a mobile number with country code, validate digits and +, space, hyphen format, for international mobile-number format checks and form validation (not authenticity).
map.依据 E.164 规则校验国际移动号码(MSISDN)格式，允许数字与 +、空格: Per E.164 rules, validate the international mobile number (MSISDN) format, allowing digits and +, spaces, hyphens; for international mobile-number format checks and form validation (not authenticity).
map.输入（MSISDN，含国家代码或不含）: Input (MSISDN, with or without country code)
map.校验带国家码手机号的数字与格式（含 +、空格、连字符）: Validate the digits and format of a country-coded mobile number (incl. +, spaces, hyphens)
map.国际短信、客服系统录入前的号码规范化检查: Normalization check of the number before international SMS or customer-service system entry
map.识别国家码与本地号码长度是否匹配: Identify whether the country code and local number length match
map.输入 +86 138 0013 8000，页面归一化后校验国家码 86 与 11: Enter +86 138 0013 8000; the page normalizes then checks country code 86 and the 11-digit local number; length or character mismatch prompts an error.
map.MSISDN = 国家码(CC) + 国内有效号码，最长 15 位；页面会归一化: MSISDN = country code (CC) + national significant number, up to 15 digits; the page normalizes away +, spaces and hyphens before checking.
map.校验通过代表号码可用吗？: Does passing validation mean the number is usable?
map.不代表。页面只校验格式与长度，号码是否在用、归属哪家运营商须实际验证。: No. The page only checks format and length; whether the number is active and which operator it belongs to must be verified.
map.为什么有些号码位数对不上？: Why do some numbers' digit counts not match?
map.不同国家的本地号码长度不同（如中国 11 位、美国 10 位），须与国家码一起判: Different countries have different local-number lengths (e.g. China 11, US 10); judge together with the country code.
